source.check: names and divisions read on the page image of the Northern Whig nominations report of 3 May 1930

note: Nomination-day report for the nine divisions of Castlereagh rural district, one member each. All were returned unopposed; Mr. James Jamison (Holywood Rural) was the only member who retired, and Mr. James M. Small was nominated in his place. Filed on Friday 30 May 1930, the day appointed by Down County Council for the county and rural district elections (Banbridge Chronicle, 15 March 1930, p. 2); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (provisional) (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
